If I could change one thing about iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, it would be to remove the new gesture that summons Siri AI by swiping down from the top. There are already so many ways to activate Siri, and I've always been used to swiping down from the top to open Notification Center, so this new gesture doesn't really affect my usage habits much.

As for the Mac, macOS 27 Golden Gate is almost entirely good news. Even though it's already late August, new beta versions keep adding many welcome changes. However, before macOS 27 officially launches next month, there's still one change I'd like to see.

macOS 27 Golden Gate makes it harder to see battery percentage on MacBook

macOS 27 Golden Gate has redesigned the battery control in the menu bar, showing only the battery icon by default rather than the percentage.

At first glance, this doesn't seem like a big deal — I've already turned off the percentage display on my iPhone, and the iPhone uses a similar battery icon. But I've always really liked seeing the battery percentage on my Mac.

If you turn on the 'Show Percentage' option in macOS 27 Golden Gate, the number is placed inside the battery icon. I assume Apple is trying to maintain design consistency with the iPhone running iOS 27.

Placing the percentage inside the iPhone battery icon is actually a compromise Apple made to accommodate the limited space to the right of the 'M-shaped notch' or Dynamic Island. But on the Mac, even in the menu bar, I've never found that there's not enough room.

Since the first developer beta, I've been running macOS 27 Golden Gate on a 15-inch MacBook Air. I found that because it's not very easy to see clearly, I've overall checked the battery percentage less often.

I hope Apple will reconsider this point in future design decisions, especially as more and more users feel this design is problematic. Meanwhile, I've at least found a workaround myself.

I used Codex to write a simple menu bar utility that clearly displays battery status and percentage to suit my needs. If you find it useful, you can download and install it for free here.
